outcome: Emotions and attitudes related to visitation restrictions
cohort: Mothers who gave birth during COVID-19 restrictions (27 mothers who had unaccompanied births and 27 matched controls who had accompanied births)
finding: Mothers who had unaccompanied births due to COVID-19-related visiting bans experienced higher levels of psychological distress, particularly anxiety and PTSS, compared to mothers who had accompanied births.
mod_finding: In both groups, women who had cesarean sections reported higher anxiety and trauma scores and lower well-being than women who had vaginal births.
